physicalDetails.detail: About fifty, good dark coat, pleasant broad face with no colour in it; shirt cuffs an inch past the sleeves, black at the edge with old brown ink and new ink with a shine; hands pressed flat on the desk. Desk tidy: inkstand, sand-pot, pen-knife, five pens trimmed to one length.
He has a wife (weeping when she left) and a trap and horse; the house smells of lavender; a marrow in the kitchen garden.

voiceMarkers.detail: Smooth, courteous, ready: 'Good morning. You'll have come up the river road. Your horses will want the trough.' Answers before the question is finished; every name 'in its column' ('Tolliver's. Tolliver and Sons, on the corn market, by the well.'); offers help (the fork past the chapel, the stone) and returns to hospitality ('You'll be wanting the trough first') whenever pressed; 'I'm sorry. If you'd come at midsummer...'

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Fled south by trap with his wife the previous day, after burning the books and papers.
goalsAtChapterEnd.underlying: Unknown. Frightened of something other than the elves, or of the elves for an unknown reason.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Absent. Alive and gone south over the bridge at a trot; the wife crying.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Swept the three barns and raked the yard; stayed to meet the party with a stove burning full of papers; lied that the books were at the regional office and the grain went north to Brill on the Brill road (six wagons, Tolliver and Sons); fled with his wife south over the bridge 'not long after the bells for morning' the next day, at a trot, without paying the toll; left a stove crammed with waybills, parchment and seals and a bad cover story.

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Lies like a ledger line: every name in its column, instant, polished. Focused his attention on the mage rather than the elves ('his attention had gone to the mage and stayed there').

howHeAddressesOthers.pattern: No title, 'my lady' not used; 'Proudmoore' is used by Sylvanas to the mage in his presence.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Squares his cuffs; hands pressed flat to the desk 'so they would not do anything else'; swallows when the staff crystal is raised; a short polite laugh at Lyriel's marrow remark that stops.

knowledge.detail: Knew they were coming (swept the depot and kept a fire for burning papers, with the answer ready). Knew enough to burn the shelf. Who told him is unknown. He may know what Barov or Andorhal hold.

arc.currentPosition: Alive and gone south with his wife; do not bring him back (per the plan).
